The round neckline features a gold zigzag embroidered border with a scalloped edge, finished with a knotted navy tassel tie. Wide sleeves carry dramatic gold crane and floral appliqué throughout, finished with a floral vine embroidered cuff strip and a distinctive gold pom-pom fringe trim.
